brief:
Two forthcoming translations will bring Palestinian poetry and Egyptian fiction to English readers this November, ArabLit reported. The month's releases include work by Palestinian poet Dalia Taha alongside a classic novel by renowned Egyptian writer Sonallah Ibrahim, a figure central to modern Arabic literature.

The publications mark continued efforts to expand access to contemporary and canonical Arab voices in English translation.
dek: Forthcoming this month are poetry from Palestine and a classic by iconic Egyptian novelist Sonallah Ibrahim.
title: ArabLit announces November 2026 translations of Palestinian poet and Egyptian novelist
